text:
[RFCS.15.1] A `CallIssued` atom records an outbound engine-initiated call
(`CallIssued`, [LFST.6.3]) as first-class provenance, so an archived
stream holds the calls a run *issued* — not only the responses it
*received* (those arrive as response facts or `CallError` facts →
`FactAssert`, [RFCS.6]). The body is `CallIssued` (`proto/call_issued.proto`,
[RFCS.15.2]); the recorder is its only producer.
